og_title: Chapter 392: Demonic Core Formed, A New Threat on the Horizon
og_description: Han Li accepts his first Core Formation failure, while Qu Hun forges a Demonic Core. Their return to a quiet island hides a disturbing truth.
twitter_title: Han Li’s first Core attempt fails; Qu Hun picks up the slack with a Demonic Core!
twitter_description: Four years of bitter cultivation ends in Han Li’s failed Core Formation, but Qu Hun’s new Demonic Core changes the game. Their homecoming? Not so peaceful.

lore_anchors.definition: A dark-aligned core alternative to the Golden Core, forged by force-feeding demonic medicines and using rapid techniques. It is faster to achieve but carries hidden costs in alignment and future bottlenecks.
The process of compressing liquid qi into a solid core—a cultivator’s first major qualitative leap. It creates visible Qi vortices and sparks celestial phenomena, alerting the surrounding region.
A powerful demonic pill that enables a cultivator to directly refine its energy into a Demonic Core, bypassing the need for conventional cultivation techniques.
A magic treasure that can barely be used by a Demonic Core cultivator of incompatible attributes. It provides a fighting chance in battles against full Core Formation cultivators.
A visible phenomenon during Core Formation where the cultivator draws the world's spiritual Qi into a massive whirlpool, signaling the event to all nearby cultivators.
The ability of a higher-level cultivator to transmit thoughts and commands to another via spiritual sense, bypassing verbal speech. Han Li uses this to coordinate with Qu Hun across chambers.

cultural_notes_faq.a: Qu Hun, Han Li's puppet, formed a Demonic Core (煞丹). Han Li himself failed to form a Golden Core.
He had no true yuan congealing after three years. His spiritual root aptitude was insufficient for a normal Core Formation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Qu Hun succeed so quickly?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He used the Blood Coagulation Five Elements Pill to directly transform his energy into a Demonic Core—a faster, dirtier, and riskier path.
A dark alternative to the Golden Core. Cheaper and faster to achieve, but often comes with hidden costs regarding technique compatibility and future cultivation bottlenecks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the big deal with the bug chamber?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is completely intact and undisturbed, which is highly suspicious. Han Li is visibly stunned, hinting at a new, unseen threat inside or nearby his hidden lab.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li leave Sea Ape Island immediately?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Qi vortex and thunder drew the attention of every local cultivator. He does not want any social entanglement or to be spied on, so he retreats the moment Qu Hun is finished.
